method: Live read-only Graphiti search_memory_facts paired depth probes (group development-knowledge, current snapshot 2026-11-06) at max_facts=12 and max_facts=24, plus the offline diagnostic replay. Percentiles use linear interpolation (numpy default / R-7).

interpretation.depth_24_vs_12: Raising max_facts from 12 to 24 raises p50 84ms -> 149ms and p95 90.1ms -> 156.2ms (approx 1.77x / 1.73x). Depth 24 recovers S01/S04 expected facts (admission-layer misses) but does NOT recover the S03/S05/S07/S10/S13 expected episodes (retrieval misses) -> the cap is not the binding constraint for those five.
interpretation.hook_note: No context-hook end-to-end instrumentation was available this campaign. A prior 256.92ms figure came from a separate disposable probe and is NOT this hook; not reused as hook latency.
interpretation.source_resolution_note: The offline diagnostic replay recorded selection/source status but did not capture per-case source-resolution wall time; no timing field is present in issue81-offline-replay.json.
